newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FORECAST - TML SEEN BOOSTED BY PRINT MEDIA.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - TML SEEN BOOSTED BY PRINT MEDIA.

text.p: South African publishing firm Times Media Ltd is set to post healthy year earnings growth next week boosted by a strong performance from its core print operations, analysts said on Friday.
The firm, which publishes Business day, The Financial Mail and the Sunday Times, has benefitted from a boom in advertising revenue as the publishing world expands in post-apartheid South Africa.
"It is looking good in terms of the print media due to the boom in magazines making the advertising pie bigger," one analyst said.

Analysts predicted earnings per share on a range of 302 to 304 cents, up from 258 cents last time with the consensus figure at 303 cents. The dividend was seen at 132 to 135 cents, up from 113 cents last time with the consensus at 133.5 cents.
The firm publishes results on Monday.
Analysts have welcomed a link-up with British publishing giant Pearson Plc which late last year saw it pay 87.5 million rand for a stake in Business Day and the Financial Mail.
The move should give Times Media a valuable international link. "It gives them access to the international scene," one analyst said.
However, Times Media's efforts to get into new electronic media may cap the extent of the firm's profits as the it takes on start up costs.
"It has had a good year on the core print operation, offset by losses in electronic media. The losses are what you would expect at start-up," said one analyst.
